summary.text: Woodson Bradley is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 42 since January 2025, succeeding Rachel Hunt, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Woodson Bradley assumed office in the North Carolina State Senate on January 1, 2025.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Appropriations on General Government and Information Technology, Education/Higher Education, and Pensions and Retirement and Aging.
